title: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer, Packer or Importer
titleHi: निर्माता, पैकर या आयातक का नाम और पूरा पता
requirement: Every package must bear a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration of the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or if the manufacturer is not the packer, both the manufacturer and packer. For imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer must be mentioned.
statutoryTextExcerpt: Every package shall bear thereon or on label securely affixed thereto, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration made in accordance with the provisions of this chapter as, to- (a) the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.
interpretationNote: LabelGuard verifies presence of either (i) manufacturer name and address, or (ii) importer name and address if marked as imported, or (iii) manufacturer and packer if distinct entities. For food items, FSSAI regulations may prescribe complementary requirements per Explanation III.

conditions.description: Name of manufacturer or brand owner must be legibly declared.

title: Month and Year of Manufacture
requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured shall be mentioned on the package.
statutoryTextExcerpt: (d) The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured shall be mentioned in the package: Provided that for packages containing food articles, the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the rules made thereunder shall apply.

title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration on Pre-Packaged Commodities
titleHi: प्री-पैकेज्ड वस्तुओं पर इकाई विक्रय मूल्य (यूनिट सेल प्राइस) की घोषणा
requirement: The unit sale price in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal places, shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodity in terms of: per gram (if < 1kg) or per kg (if > 1kg); per ml (if < 1L) or per litre (if > 1L); per cm (if < 1m) or per metre (if > 1m); per number or unit. Not required where retail price equals unit price.
statutoryTextExcerpt: “(11) The unit sale price in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal place, shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodities in the following manner, namely:- (i) per gram where net quantity is less than one kilogram and per kilogram where net quantity is more than one kilogram; (ii) per centimeter where net length is less than one metre and per metre where net length is more than one metre; (iii) per mililitre where net volume is less than one litre and per litre where net volume is more than one litre; (iv) per number or unit if any item is sold by number or unit... Provided further that declaration of unit sale price is not required for the pre-packaged commodities in which retail sale price is equal to the unit sale price.”
interpretationNote: Introduced by GSR 779(E) and amended by GSR 226(E). Enables consumers to compare prices across varying package volumes/weights.

conditions.description: Unit sale price must be declared according to the applicable metric denomination.

evidenceRequirements.description: Bounding box identifying unit sale price text (e.g., '₹ 0.25 / g').

title: Minimum Numeral and Letter Height on Principal Display Panel
titleHi: मुख्य प्रदर्शन पैनल पर अंकों और अक्षरों की न्यूनतम ऊंचाई
requirement: The height of any numeral and letter in the mandatory declaration on the principal display panel shall not be less than the minimum height specified in Table-I based on the area of the principal display panel (A): A <= 50 cm²: 1.0mm (blown/molded: 2.0mm); 50 < A <= 100 cm²: 1.5mm (blown/molded: 3.0mm); 100 < A <= 500 cm²: 2.5mm (blown/molded: 4.0mm); 500 < A <= 2500 cm²: 4.0mm (blown/molded: 6.0mm); A > 2500 cm²: 6.0mm (blown/molded: 6.0mm).
statutoryTextExcerpt: “(2) The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration required under these rules shall be as per Table-I... Table-I: Area of Principal display panel in square centimeters (A), Minimum height of numerals and letters in millimeters: A <= 50 -> 1.0mm; 50 < A <= 100 -> 1.5mm; 100 < A <= 500 -> 2.5mm; 500 < A <= 2500 -> 4.0mm; 2500 < A -> 6.0mm.”
interpretationNote: Width of numeral/letter must be at least one-third of its height (except for '1', 'i', 'I', 'l'). Ensures legibility to consumers.

conditions.description: Font size must equal or exceed statutory millimeter thresholds for package panel area.

evidenceRequirements.description: Pixel-to-millimeter calibrated optical measurement of declaration letters.

title: Prohibition on Individual Alteration Stickers (Except for Lowering MRP)
titleHi: व्यक्तिगत परिवर्तन स्टिकर का निषेध (एमआरपी घटाने को छोड़कर)
requirement: It shall not be permissible to affix individual stickers on the package for altering or making declarations required under these rules. Provided that for reducing the Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker with the revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed and the same shall not cover the original MRP declaration.
statutoryTextExcerpt: (3) It shall not be permissible to affix individual stickers on the package for altering or making declaration required under these rules: Provided that for reducing the Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker with the revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed and the same shall not cover the MRP declaration made by the manufacturer or the packer, as the case may be, on the label of the package.
interpretationNote: Over-stickering or paste-overs to alter manufacturing dates, net quantity, or increase price is strictly prohibited. Only non-covering lower MRP discount stickers are lawful.

title: Statutory Exemption for Packages of Net Quantity 10g or 10ml or Less
titleHi: 10 ग्राम या 10 मिली या उससे कम शुद्ध मात्रा वाले पैकेटों के लिए वैधानिक छूट
requirement: Nothing contained in these rules shall apply to any package containing a commodity if the net weight or measure of the commodity is ten gram or ten millilitre or less, if sold by weight or measure. Provided that the provisions of this clause shall not be applicable for tobacco and tobacco products.
statutoryTextExcerpt: 26. Exemption in respect of certain packages. -Nothing contained in these rules shall apply to any package containing a commodity if— (a) the net weight or measure of the commodity is ten gram or ten millilitre or less, if sold by weight or measure; Provided that the provisions of this clause shall not be applicable for tobacco and tobacco products.
interpretationNote: Small sachet packages (e.g. single-use shampoo/sauce sachets <= 10g/ml) are exempted from general Chapter II declarations under Rule 26(a). Crucially, tobacco products (such as gutkha, khaini, bidis) are explicitly denied this exemption by GSR 385(E).

conditions.description: Package net quantity is equal to or less than 10g or 10ml.

evidenceRequirements.description: Net weight verification <= 10g/10ml.

amendmentHistory.changeSummary: Inserted proviso that exemption shall not apply to tobacco and tobacco products.
